It hasn't been bestowed in thousands of years.|audio=TheresaTitle.flac|Master [[Jaric Kaedan]], on the title of Barsen'thor, which originated with Lorjan Sakku|<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />}}
'''Lorjan Sakku''' was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who was [[Jedi training/Legends|apprenticed]] to a [[Lorjan Sakku's Jedi Master|Cerean Jedi Master]] [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the conflict known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After Lorjan's brother, [[Lyhesh Sakku|Lyhesh]], went insane and threatened the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Lorjan redeemed his brother but [[Death/Legends|died]] in the process. Lorjan's sacrifice was remembered by his [[Lorjan Sakku's Jedi Master|Master]], who named her deceased Padawan the "[[Barsen'thor]]," which translated to "Warden of the Order" from her native [[Cerean (language)|Cerean language]]. The title was adopted by the Jedi Order for future use, and it was awarded to exceptional members of the Order.

==Biography==
{{Quote|In all our millennia of history, you will be the third to carry the title.|audio=YouWillBeTheThird.flac|Jedi Master [[Syo Bakarn]], to the third Barsen'thor|<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />}}
Lorjan Sakku was an individual<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> who lived [[Millennium/Legends|thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]<ref name="Date" /> and had a brother named [[Lyhesh Sakku|Lyhesh]], with both being [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. Lorjan was eventually discovered and chosen by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], becoming a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] to a [[Lorjan Sakku's Jedi Master|Cerean female]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. At one point, Lorjan's brother became a victim of an attempted [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]]. Lyhesh survived, but the incident drove him insane, and the man became a threat to the Jedi Order.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Lorjan bravely defended the Order against his own maddened brother, successfully redeeming Lyhesh and allowing him to serve [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] again, but Lorjan had [[Death/Legends|sacrificed his life]] in the process. In recognition of his actions, Lorjan's Master posthumously bestowed upon him the title of "[[Barsen'thor]]"&mdash;which translated to "Warden of the Order" from her native [[Cerean (language)|Cerean language]]. In honor of Lorjan's sacrifice, the Jedi Order retained the title and awarded it to exceptional Jedi,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> although only [[Barsen'thor (second)|two]] [[The Barsen'thor|individuals]] had received it by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Cold War.<ref name="Vivicar Awaits">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Consular|Vivicar Awaits|Tython}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Lorjan Sakku was a selfless individual who risked his life to stop his own brother from harming the Jedi. Believing in the possibility of redemption for his sibling, Lorjan successfully brought Lyhesh back from his poison-induced delirium, even though it had cost him his life. Lorjan's Master then commemorated her Padawan with the title of Barsen'thor, and the Jedi Order adapted the title for future use,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> awarding it to Jedi who displayed skill and wisdom comparable to Lorjan's.<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" />

==Powers and abilities==
Lorjan Sakku was a Force-sensitive individual and a member of the Jedi Order. However, before he was able to finish his training with his Master, he died while trying to stop his brother, who had become a threat to the Jedi.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lorjan Sakku was first indirectly mentioned in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Although his name was not revealed, the game established that the playable [[Jedi Consular]] character was only the third person in the history of the Jedi Order to carry the title of Barsen'thor.<ref name="Vivicar Awaits" /> In [[2012]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' established Sakku's name in an entry on Jedi ceremonial titles.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
